description.add-passkey: Registers a passkey on the device you are currently signed in from.
description.cardmarket-condition: Cardmarket hides every offer graded worse than this.
description.cardmarket-finish: Cardmarket shows only offers with your cards' finish, foil for foil and regular for regular.
description.cardmarket-language: Cardmarket shows only offers in the language your card is printed in. A German card then leads to German offers.
description.cardmarket-region: Which country page of Cardmarket the link opens. Changes the language of the page itself, not the offers.
description.cardmarket-seller-country: Cardmarket shows only offers from sellers in this country. Saves cross-border postage.
description.current-username: You log in as {{username}}. Others see your profile and decks under this name.
description.delete-account: Deletes your account along with its passkeys, collections, watch lists and every deck that is not public. Public decklists stay readable, with nobody named as their builder.
description.delete-account-anonymous: There you then appear as “Gelöschter Spieler” (German for deleted player) with a number.
description.delete-account-confirm: There is no way back. Your account, your passkeys, your collections, your watch lists and every deck you kept to yourself are gone afterwards.
description.delete-account-decks: Your public decklists stay reachable under their links. Nobody is named as their builder afterwards.
description.delete-account-tournaments: In other people's tournaments you stay on as a guest under your last username, unless you choose below to appear anonymously. In your own tournaments your username stays. A co-organizer takes over the tournaments you own; without one, public and unlisted tournaments stay reachable without an owner and private ones are deleted.
description.foil-tilt: The sheen on foil cards follows how you tilt your device, the way a card held in the hand catches the light.
description.language: Applies to the interface. Card names come from Scryfall and are unaffected.
description.passkeys: These devices can sign you in. Add a passkey per device — if you lose one, the others still get you in.
description.proxy-fade: Cards marked as proxies are drawn washed out in the deck, so a stand-in never passes for the real card at a glance.
description.push-device: Get notifications on this device. You sign up each device on its own.
description.push-unavailable: This browser cannot receive notifications. On iPhone and iPad they only work once the app is added to the home screen.
description.remove-passkey: You will no longer be able to sign in with "{{label}}". The only way back is to add the device again.
description.rename-account: Your old name is free for others right away, and links to your old profile stop working. Links to your decks and your passkeys keep working. From then on, log in with the new name.
description.rename-passkey: Only you see this name. It tells your devices apart in this list.
description.theme: “Match system” follows your device's setting and changes along with it.
description.tournament-pushes: For example when a round is paired, with your table and seat. Applies to all your devices.

error.aborted: Cancelled. Press "Add this device" again and confirm your device's prompt.
error.already-registered: This device is already registered as a passkey.
error.authenticator-error: Your device could not create a passkey. Check that a screen lock or PIN is set up.
error.delete-failed: The account could not be deleted. Please try again.
error.insecure-context: Passkeys only work over a secure connection. Open the page via HTTPS or localhost.
error.rejected: The passkey could not be stored. Please try again.
error.unknown: The passkey could not be created. Please try again.
error.unsupported: This browser does not support passkeys. Use an up-to-date Chrome, Firefox or Safari.
error.username-mismatch: That is not your name. Type your username exactly as it is shown above.
error.wrong-domain: The page is running under a different address than the one passkeys are registered for.

label.delete-account-anonymous: Appear anonymously in other people's tournaments

toast.foil-tilt-denied: This needs access to the motion sensors. You can allow it again in your browser's settings.
toast.foil-tilt-silent: Your browser is not reporting any motion. Brave blocks the sensors by default: allow them under Settings → Site settings → Motion sensors. They are also unavailable over http rather than https.
toast.push-denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser's settings.
toast.push-failed: This device could not be signed up.
